source_snapshot.procedure: Run OOB `ipmitool ... raw 0x0a 0x41` and inspect post-test logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: Command should be sent without any error.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek selects the correct raw command but the merged output instruction is unrelated sensor-get text. It also leaves the nine-byte allocation response and optional-command interpretation to the user.

original_test_intent.purpose: Validate the optional OOB IPMI Get SEL Allocation Info command by decoding the SEL repository's allocation geometry and internally checking the reported capacity/free-region values without modifying the repository.
original_test_intent.target: The selected BMC's SEL device, Storage net function 0x0A command 0x41, accessed through the verified protected `lanplus` endpoint.
original_test_intent.scope: Issue one read, validate completion and exactly nine response-data bytes, decode possible units, unit size, free units, largest free block and maximum record size, handle 0000h unspecified fields, and correlate with Get SEL Info support/free-space metadata. SEL record contents or actual writeability are not tested.
original_test_intent.operation: Preserve the SEL, verify BMC identity and Get SEL Info support bit, run raw 0x0A/0x41 once, parse all little-endian fields, compute specified byte capacities and invariants without treating 0000h as zero capacity, record fragmentation indicators only when fields are specified, and prove no Reserve/Add/Delete/Clear command ran.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: The workbook estimates 10 attended and 5 machine minutes and specifies one OOB query.
original_test_intent.expected_result: If the platform advertises support, completion is successful and nine data bytes are structurally valid; specified unit size is at least 16 bytes, largest free block does not exceed free units, free/total calculations are coherent with allowed saturation/unspecified behavior, and maximum record size is reported in allocation units. Unsupported is not a failure unless platform support is required.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: BMC/firmware/channel/tool identity; Get SEL Info support bit and repository context; exact redacted request/response, completion and nine-byte length; raw and decoded five fields; specified capacity/invariant calculations and FFFFh/0000h handling; scope statement that no entry-integrity/write test occurred; non-mutation audit.
ambiguities: The source criterion checks only command error and does not require response decoding or geometry validation.
The merged `ai_logs_output` refers to a sensor named `Status Check - STATUS`, which is unrelated to SEL allocation and must not be used.
Get SEL Allocation Info is optional and the source does not state whether this platform requires support.
Allocation geometry does not prove that existing SEL entries are semantically correct or that a new record can be written.
The source requests clearing logs, which would alter the repository being measured.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly keeps FULLY AUTOMATABLE, preserves the SEL, parses all five fields, handles optional/unspecified behavior and separates geometry from entry content. It does not explicitly repair the merged sensor-output instruction, require the exact nine-byte response, or anchor optional support to the Get SEL Info operation-support bit before interpreting an unsupported result.

applicable_history.decision: The same code appears on another workbook row, so identity is fixed to Functionality row 1194 and its SEL Allocation item; no content from row 2032 may be reused.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep FULLY AUTOMATABLE and make evidence byte-accurate. V3 explicitly rejects the unrelated sensor-output overlay, requires the nine-byte allocation response, checks the Get SEL Info support bit and limits conclusions to repository geometry rather than entry integrity or writeability.

available_now: The exact standard read command, response layout and little-endian fields are defined.
The operation is read-only and needs no mutation approval on the authorized lab BMC.
Get SEL Info provides a standard support bit and related free-space context for interpretation.
missing_inputs: At runtime resolve the BMC endpoint, protected credentials, firmware/tool identity and whether the platform contract requires this optional command.
If a product-specific capacity value is to be judged, the platform requirement must be supplied; the standard alone defines structure, not a universal SEL size.
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: Lab inventory supplies the target and protected credential source; the platform owner supplies any mandatory support/capacity requirement. No interactive input is needed for ordinary structural collection.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: The complete query, Get SEL Info correlation and arithmetic checks are safe read-only work on the authorized target.
prohibited_until_closed: Do not clear SEL, reserve/add/delete records, inject events, infer entry correctness/writeability, use the unrelated sensor output, or mark optional unsupported behavior FAIL without a platform requirement.
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: Verify target and support bit, receive a successful nine-byte response when support is advertised, decode every field with special-value handling, record invariant results and preserve proof that only read commands ran.

revision_candidate.test_name: OOB SEL Allocation Geometry Read and Validation
revision_candidate.purpose: Read and validate the SEL allocation geometry through standard OOB IPMI while preserving all repository contents and limiting conclusions to capacity and free-region metadata.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact BMC/firmware with a protected `lanplus` endpoint; optional command support is interpreted against Get SEL Info and the platform requirement.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One BMC SEL allocation-info response and related read-only SEL Info metadata. Record content, event generation and repository mutation are outside scope.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: BMC/firmware/endpoint identity; protected credentials; qualified `ipmitool` and nine-byte parser; optional-support requirement and any platform capacity specification; preserved SEL context.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Verify target and Get SEL Info support, then execute `ipmitool ... raw 0x0a 0x41` once. Require successful completion and nine data bytes; decode possible units, unit size, free units and largest block as four little-endian 16-bit values plus one-byte maximum record size; handle 0000h unspecified, calculate only specified capacities, cross-check coherent support/free-space context and archive non-mutation evidence.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Correct BMC and protected OOB session verified; parser/tool qualified; SEL preserved; optional support expectation known or reported without a PASS/FAIL claim; no concurrent SEL clear/delete operation.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Target/firmware/tool identity; Get SEL Info operation support and repository context; redacted raw 41h response; completion/length; decoded five fields, units and special values; invariant/capacity calculations; explicit scope limitation; no-mutation audit.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Intel IPMI 2.0 rev. 1.1 sections 31.2 and 31.3/Table 31-3 plus the exact platform support/capacity requirement when one exists.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Never clear/reserve/add/delete the SEL, inject events, expose credentials, interpret 0000h as real zero capacity, use unrelated sensor evidence or claim geometry proves content integrity/write success.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: None for authorized read-only collection. An owner decision is needed only to judge optional unsupported behavior or a product-specific capacity mismatch.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: The agent can execute, parse and validate standard invariants. The owner supplies and judges any platform-specific mandatory support or capacity value.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: No recovery is expected. On malformed/inconsistent output, preserve raw SEL Info/allocation evidence and stop interpretation; do not mutate the repository to test the result.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Target/session mismatch; active SEL erase; nonzero completion when support is required; response not nine bytes; impossible specified geometry; parser ambiguity; credential exposure; or any request to mutate the SEL.

identified_defects: The merged output instruction requests unrelated sensor evidence.
The source accepts only command success and does not validate the nine-byte allocation payload.
V2 does not explicitly gate optional-support interpretation with the Get SEL Info support bit.
Source log clearing would change the repository context.
reason_for_change: Retain V2's correct automation decision while removing a concrete cross-row sensor-output contamination, enforcing the normative response length/support bit and preventing geometry from being overclaimed as entry integrity or writeability.

new_technical_evidence.title: Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev. 1.1 E7 Markup
new_technical_evidence.applicability: BMC SEL devices implementing optional Storage command 41h
new_technical_evidence.supports: The no-data request returns nine data bytes for possible units, allocation-unit size, free units, largest free block and maximum record size; 0000h can mean unspecified, allocation unit size must support at least 16 bytes, and Get SEL Info advertises command support.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Platform-mandated support and expected capacity remain product-specific.

removed_ambiguities: Replaces the unrelated sensor output with SEL allocation evidence.
Defines exact response length and field units.
Separates optional support and repository geometry from content/writeability claims.
resolved_blockers: None; V2 already established a safe complete read path.
remaining_blockers: Only platform-specific support/capacity judgment remains conditional; ordinary structural execution is ready.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 fixes a concrete cross-row evidence error and makes support/length/scope acceptance explicit without changing V2's correct read-only classification.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The contract keeps the V2 automation class and is queued for scheduled isolated validation.
